title.zh: 【三井住友 FG 拟向 SBI 与 Startale Group 合资公司出资 5%，合作拓展日元稳定币业务】
title.en: 【三井住友 FG 拟向 SBI 与 Startale Group 合资公司出资 5%，合作拓展日元稳定币业务】

current_state.zh: Mitsui Sumitomo Financial Group plans to acquire 5% of SBI Startale Marketing and partner with SBI to expand use of the yen stablecoin JPYSC in asset management, payments and on-chain settlement.
current_state.en: Mitsui Sumitomo Financial Group plans to acquire 5% of SBI Startale Marketing and partner with SBI to expand use of the yen stablecoin JPYSC in asset management, payments and on-chain settlement.
